rows: Remove card OSC.DRV and insert it in the extension card (Extender board) so that the words "Transmitter up" are at the top when adjusting the transmitter, then insert card OSC.DRV again in the extension card.

sections_target.text: Second: adjust the frequency of FC - 0.250 kHz Trip.

rows: Put the TSS test switch in Trip position.
Put the frequency counter cable on J23 or on the two points (Out, Com) on card OSC,DRV.
Adjust the frequency from capacitor C21 within 3 Hz.
Return the test switch to Off position to verify the Guard frequency, then return card OSC-DRV to its correct place.

sections_target.text: Adjust and measure the Level at J23 using a Selective voltmeter.

rows: Put the test switch in Off position.
Connect the Selective instrument cable to J23.
Tune the Selective instrument frequency to the Guard frequency whose Level is to be measured.
Adjust the Guard signal Level from resistor R45 on card OSC.DRV up to the peak of 250 ± 5 mV.
Put the test switch in Trip position after making sure that the test switch of the receiver (of the same transmitter) at the other station is in Test position.
Connect the Selective instrument cable to J23.
Tune the Selective instrument to the Trip frequency whose Level is to be measured.
Adjust the Trip signal Level from resistor R42 on card OSC.DRV up to the peak (500 ± 20 mV).

sections_target.text: Steps for testing the receiver CR-61A

rows: Put the TSR test switch in Test position.
Measure 125 VDC using the digital AVO (125 ± 7 VDC) on the card at the two points (NEGBAT, Pos BAT).
Adjust (48 ± 1 VDC) on card PWR, AUX at the two points (A48, com).
Adjust (36 ± 1 VDC) on card Filter at the two points (a+36, com).
Measure the frequency FC ± 29 kHz ± 2 Hz at the two points (LOC.OSC, com) using the frequency counter on card OSC.MIXER.
Measure the RF frequency received from the other side, FC + 0.250 kHz ± 3 Hz, at the two points (RF, com).
Adjust RFIN from resistor R3 on the Filter card up to 18 dBm at (Com, IF out) on card OSC.MIXER using a Selective Voltmeter.
Adjust the CCM meter up to 2 mA using resistor R86 on card signal noise, carrier level monitor.
Measure Guard out using a digital AVO at the two points Guard out, com on card Discriminator, to be 51 VDC.

Introduction
Power Line Carrier (PLC) equipment on power transmission lines at power stations is no less important than the protection equipment installed at those stations, as the work of this equipment complements the role of protection. Since, when a short circuit occurs on the tie line between two power stations, the protection equipment at each station trips only the equipment connected to it at that same station, without being able to trip the equipment of the other side, then when protection operates at one side of the tie, the line remains in service until the protection equipment at the next tie side plays its role in tripping its equipment. It was therefore necessary to use PLC equipment so that trip commands can be transferred between the two sides of the tie without waiting for the protection equipment at both sides of the tie to operate each on its own.
Safety Precautions
Issue an approved work order and provide the occupational safety and health category card for workers.
Disconnect the line concerned by the maintenance from both sides and earth it.
Erect a fence around the work place and place the appropriate warning signs.
Put the test switches at both stations of the tie line in test position.

Measure 36 VDC on card (PWR.AMPL/REG) at the two points (a+36, com) and adjust it from resistor R6 within (1 V). | 4.
Adjust and measure the frequency at J23.

Second: adjust the frequency of FC - 0.250 kHz Trip.

First: adjust 250 mV Guard level.

Connect the Selective instrument cable to J23. | 2.
Tune the Selective instrument to the Trip frequency whose Level is to be measured. | 3.
Adjust the Trip signal Level from resistor R42 on card OSC.DRV up to the peak (500 ± 20 mV). | 4.
Steps for testing the receiver CR-61A
Put the TSR test switch in Test position. | 1.
Measure 125 VDC using the digital AVO (125 ± 7 VDC) on the card at the two points (NEGBAT, Pos BAT). | 2.
Adjust (48 ± 1 VDC) on card PWR, AUX at the two points (A48, com). | 3.
Adjust (36 ± 1 VDC) on card Filter at the two points (a+36, com). | 4.
Measure the frequency FC ± 29 kHz ± 2 Hz at the two points (LOC.OSC, com) using the frequency counter on card OSC.MIXER. | 5.
Measure the RF frequency received from the other side, FC + 0.250 kHz ± 3 Hz, at the two points (RF, com). | 6.
Adjust RFIN from resistor R3 on the Filter card up to 18 dBm at (Com, IF out) on card OSC.MIXER using a Selective Voltmeter. | 7.
Adjust the CCM meter up to 2 mA using resistor R86 on card signal noise, carrier level monitor. | 8.
Measure Guard out using a digital AVO at the two points Guard out, com on card Discriminator, to be 51 VDC. | 9.
